marketDirection.headline: Indian market is under pressure today.

reasons.text: Nifty 50 closed -0.34% at 22,811, above its 20-DMA, below the 50-DMA (falling), below the 200-DMA.
The index is up 0.4% over the last five sessions — downtrend structure intact.
Market breadth is defensive — 17.8% of scanned NSE stocks advancing, 20.2% above their 50-DMA.
Steady order accretion solidifies the base near ₹360–365, giving swing setups a fundamental cushion for a retest of ₹385 overhead resistance.
Breakdown below 22,700 shifts the broad market swing posture to defensive, mandating trailing stops and tight position sizing on long breakout trades.

marketDirection.disclaimer: A rules-based read of index price, market breadth and headline flow — not a forecast or trading advice.

marketSummary: Indian equities are facing selling pressure with the Nifty 50 sliding below the 22,650 support shelf, weighed down by sharp losses in metals, autos, and power equipment alongside rising crude oil prices and high global bond yields. Despite net institutional buying by FIIs (₹1,022 Cr) and DIIs (₹1,614 Cr) in the preceding session, risk appetite remains restrained. The notable exception is the IT pack, where heavyweights and select mid-caps are displaying robust relative strength ahead of marquee Q2 earnings.
dailyFocus: Prioritize relative-strength leadership in IT setups and high-conviction order-backed defence counters while keeping position sizes tight. Key binary earnings catalysts (Infosys, CG Power, Coforge on Oct 23; Trent on Oct 29) dictate respecting technical stop levels and waiting for high-volume base confirmation before deploying multi-week swing capital.

sectors.name: Information Technology
sectors.reason: Exhibiting textbook counter-trend accumulation; Nifty IT surged nearly 2.9% while benchmark indices cracked, driven by rotation into cash-rich services ahead of key earnings.
catalysts: Infosys and Coforge Q2 FY27 results and management guidance on October 23
Institutional capital rotation out of high-beta cyclicals into cash-flow stable tech
risks: Potential downward revisions to FY27 discretionary spending guidance
Spillover volatility from US tech earnings

sectors.name: Defence & Aerospace
sectors.reason: Steady domestic procurement order momentum continues to provide multi-quarter backlog visibility, offering price support near multi-week consolidation floors.
catalysts: Ministry of Defence procurement allocations and fresh radar/avionics contracts
Upcoming Q2 board meets and capacity expansions
risks: Intraday sell-offs in broader PSU baskets during market-wide risk-off days
Supply chain execution timelines for specialized electronic hardware

sectors.name: Retail & Consumption
sectors.reason: Clear stock divergence: fast-fashion leaders like Trent maintain aggressive growth and store rollouts, while broader consumer names face inflationary margin pressure.
catalysts: Trent Q2 FY27 results scheduled for October 29
Festive season demand uptick across Tier-2 and Tier-3 store footprints
risks: Elevated price-to-earnings multiples vulnerable to any post-earnings growth deceleration
Discretionary spending fatigue in urban centers

sectors.name: Capital Goods & Power
sectors.reason: Sector experiencing profit booking and broad index drag, with industrial equipment names pausing near intermediate moving averages ahead of Q2 earnings tests.
catalysts: CG Power Q2 results on October 23
Medium-term transmission grid capex and data-center power equipment demand
risks: Working capital elongation and margin compression from elevated input costs
Sharp institutional profit booking in extended industrial momentum plays

news.headline: BEL Bags ₹1,011 Crore in Fresh Defence Orders Alongside ₹770 Crore MoD Radar Deal
news.summary: Bharat Electronics Limited announced additional orders worth ₹1,011 crore received since October 13, 2026, encompassing radars, communication equipment, sonars, and jammers. In addition, the Ministry of Defence entered into a ₹770 crore capital acquisition contract with BEL for indigenously developed Improved Low-Level Lightweight Radars (LLLR-I) for the Indian Army.
news.impact: Steady order accretion solidifies the base near ₹360–365, giving swing setups a fundamental cushion for a retest of ₹385 overhead resistance.

news.headline: Nifty Breaks Below 22,650 on Commodity Pressure and Asia Pullback Despite Institutional Net Inflows
news.summary: The Nifty 50 breached its short-term 22,700 technical support shelf on October 22, 2026, weighed down by oil above $100 and sharp losses in metals and autos. Exchange data confirmed that FIIs bought ₹1,022.32 crore and DIIs purchased ₹1,614.32 crore on October 21, but institutional buying failed to halt broader weakness.
news.impact: Breakdown below 22,700 shifts the broad market swing posture to defensive, mandating trailing stops and tight position sizing on long breakout trades.

news.headline: Infosys Schedules Q2 Results on October 23 as IT Sector Defies Broad Market Slump
news.summary: Infosys will announce its Q2 FY27 results and interim dividend on October 23, 2026. Market scrutiny centers on sequential constant currency revenue growth, AI contract integration (now over 8% of revenues), and possible refinements to its full-year revenue outlook.
news.impact: Primary sector bellwether event that will determine whether Nifty IT's multi-week cup-and-handle pattern confirms a breakout or succumbs to a bull trap.

news.headline: Nifty IT Surges Nearly 3% Against the Tide Led by Broad Institutional Accumulation
news.summary: The Nifty IT index rallied 2.88% to 32,422 at the close of October 21, leading all sectoral indices as heavyweights Infosys, TCS, and Wipro logged strong volume gains. The move confirms rotation away from cyclical sectors toward software exporters benefiting from recent rupee stabilization.
news.impact: Exhibits prime relative strength divergence; pullback setups within large-cap IT offer the highest probability swing setups in the current market environment.

news.headline: Trent Confirms October 29 Board Meeting for Q2 Results Following 23% Revenue Jump
news.summary: Trent has scheduled its Q2 FY27 board meeting for October 29, 2026. The print follows an earlier business update indicating a 23% YoY jump in standalone revenue to ₹5,788 crore and the crossing of 1,000 Zudio stores, set against broader management shifts following Harish Bhat's exit.
news.impact: Consolidation below the ₹2,900 pivot represents high-and-tight base building; the scheduled Oct 29 print is the definitive volume trigger for an attempt at ₹3,000+.

news.headline: Coforge Consolidates Under Highs Ahead of October 23 Q2 Earnings Board Meeting
news.summary: Coforge Limited will report its Q2 FY27 earnings on October 23, 2026. The stock closed at ₹1,957.90 on October 21, holding tight trading ranges just below its 52-week peak of ₹2,021.20 as mid-cap IT peers experience strong institutional interest.
news.impact: Tight coiling within 3% of 52-week highs makes this a textbook pre-earnings contraction pattern; an earnings beat can ignite an immediate stage-2 breakout above ₹2,025.

news.headline: CG Power Convenes Board Meeting on October 23 to Consider Q2 Results
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions has formally notified stock exchanges that its board of directors will meet on October 23, 2026, to review and approve standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, to be followed by an analyst earnings call.
news.impact: Compression into the ₹810–820 band sets up a binary volatility catalyst on Oct 23; traders should wait for post-earnings volume above ₹840 before taking swing positions.

news.headline: Reliance Industries Backed as Jio Platforms ₹30,230-Crore IPO Subscribed Over 3.4x
news.summary: The mega ₹30,230-crore IPO of Reliance Industries' telecom and digital flagship Jio Platforms achieved 3.48x total subscription on Day 2, powered by 9.4x oversubscription in the Qualified Institutional Buyer (QIB) book, ahead of its scheduled October 23 close and October 28 listing.
news.impact: Massive institutional demand and liquidity absorption underpin solid support for parent Reliance above ₹1,200, insulating it from deeper index corrections.

news.headline: HDFC Bank Q2 PAT Rises 4.7% to ₹19,510 Crore; Margin Compression Narrows Lending Spreads
news.summary: HDFC Bank reported standalone Q2 FY27 net profit of ₹19,510 crore, up 4.7% YoY, broadly in line with expectations, while NII climbed 9.7% to ₹34,619 crore. However, reported NIM on total assets contracted by 10 bps QoQ to 3.16%, driven by the elevated funding costs of FCNR(B) deposits, even as GNPA improved to 1.11%.
news.impact: Persistent margin pressure caps upside momentum, confining the stock to a wide ₹710–740 trading range and preventing a near-term Bank Nifty breakout.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Subsidiary Wins Luxury Cruise Order; Company Clarifies Export Pipeline
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard's subsidiary Hooghly-CSL secured a contract valued up to ₹250 crore from Heritage River Journeys for two luxury cruise vessels on the Brahmaputra River. In an exchange clarification under Regulation 30(11), CSL clarified that broader market reports of 40-ship foreign orders reflect public prospective discussions rather than additional new signed commitments.
news.impact: Confirmed inland orders buffer the bottom of the multi-week consolidation range, but declining volume requires an overhead trendline breakout before swing entry.

news.headline: HAL Expands Engine Manufacturing with Second Koraput Shakti Production Line
news.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has advanced construction on a dedicated second production line for Shakti helicopter engines at its Koraput facility in Odisha, aimed at accelerating deliveries for Dhruv ALH and Prachand combat helicopters ahead of its forthcoming Q2 financial disclosures.
news.impact: Capacity additions bolster order execution visibility, firming up support around the ₹4,750–4,850 level as the stock builds the right handle of a multi-month base.
